scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @nearby/shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @nearby/shared && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend && node --import tsx --test tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @nearby/shared && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test:unit -w backend && node --import tsx --test tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.predev: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:shared
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @nearby/shared && npm run clean -w frontend && npm run clean -w backend
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx --test tests/integration/*.test.ts
